listing.name: Street Fighter EX2 Plus Recompiled
listing.summary: Register a completed upstream-prepared Street Fighter EX2 Plus Windows player using your own USA disc and required retail BIOS.

steps.title: Complete the title’s supported preparation upstream
steps.instruction: Complete the supported upstream setup from your own USA SLUS-01105 CUE and every associated BIN before attachment. The release-root Street_Fighter_EX2_Plus.exe is a setup host; it generates and builds the completed game in build-release. Keep the whole creating project and output together. Portcove does not run that preparation or distribute its private generated game code.

steps.title: Use the matching original and setup procedure
steps.instruction: Provide your own USA SCPH1001 retail BIOS: this title requires the 512 KiB image identified upstream by CRC32 37157331 and sets openbios=false. The generic packaged README-SETUP description of optional BIOS/OpenBIOS does not override this title requirement. Complete the title-specific BIOS setup upstream.

steps.title: Add the completed supported game program
steps.instruction: Select the completed build-release/Street_Fighter_EX2_Plus.exe with its executable directory as working directory and --launcher as the literal argument. Do not attach the release-root setup host or an SDK emitter. The completed game-dispatch binary bypasses setup forwarding; its native main owns launcher/game execution.

steps.title: Review launch details and manage updates
steps.instruction: Review the selected game executable, working folder and launch arguments, then agree to use them. Choose Play separately when you are ready. You manage setup, game replacement and recovery. Removing the registration leaves external files in place. Before changing versions, close the game and its companion programs and keep the working copy and every data location it uses. Review and select the changed executable before playing again. Portcove does not offer updates, backups, rollback, conversion, data migration or deletion for these external files.

steps.title: Preserve the whole creating copy and effective data
steps.instruction: Keep the complete creating project/build-release, original CUE/BIN, own BIOS and generated game code. Preserve settings.toml, input.ini, configured memory cards, states, mods, controller mappings, caches, backups and all effective custom roots. Do not assume compatibility with Street Fighter EX Plus Alpha or another PSXrecomp fork. Retain the framework PolyForm and separate third-party notices and comply with applicable component terms.

warnings: Use only a copy and components you are permitted to use. Keep the complete working game, originals, saves, settings, mods, caches, backups and every custom data location before changing versions. Another executable may use those same locations. These instructions do not establish Portcove-managed installation, gameplay or save compatibility.
